capabilities: Preview notes by hovering nodes in the graph view
Edit notes in a companion sidebar pane
Create notes at a clicked or right-clicked graph position
Create notes that conform to an active graph filter (path, tag, or search term)
extras: The README warns that the plugin uses undocumented internals of Obsidian's graph renderer, so future updates may break it. Manual installation only; support is via GitHub issues.
intentEvidence: The graph stops being a read-only map and becomes the place you actually work.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is read-only: you can see notes but must switch to other panes to preview, edit, or create them.
summary: Graph-first workflow plugin that adds a companion pane for previewing, editing, and creating notes directly from the graph view.
